newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to auction 150 bln dong T-notes Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to auction 150 bln dong T-notes Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 150 billion dong ($12.84 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the central State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on July 23, the bank sold 16.6 billion dong worth of one-year notes to domestic institutions at an annual interest rate of 11.0 percent.
The government has held 18 Treasury paper auctions so far this year, through which a total of 1,186 billion dong worth of Treasury stock has been issued. ($1 = 11,680 dong)
